Story: Hilda grew up on the rugged coast of Jarlshavn, learning to wield an axe and shield from a young age. Her strength and dedication quickly made her a formidable warrior. She joined the longship crew to prove her worth and honor her ancestors, serving as a reliable and brave shieldmaiden.
